lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly regular 2D array of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in parallel longitudinal rows starting posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows, forming a geometric grid where the circular blobs serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible; the most prominent ridge displays a sharp vertical contrast gradient (light upper, shadowed lower) running horizontally across the mid-lateral flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 6-10 small, low-contrast high-luminance blobs located primarily on the anterior half of the first dorsal fin's lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the upper-mid lateral flank, characterized by an elongated silhouette with a distinct longitudinal stripe, acting as a temporal attachment.
